headline: meets the required rate with x16.0 headroom AND a byte-identical, lock-free correctness guarantee

throughput_gate.name: throughput
throughput_gate.measured: 800 M/s at 8 banks (linear: 100 M/s per bank)

correctness_gate.name: correctness
correctness_gate.required: byte-identical regardless of arrival order / parallelism
correctness_gate.detail: 'sum' (modular integer sum (counters, totals, moments)) is an abelian aggregation, so the merge is provably order-independent — lock-free, no serialization

scope_note: Throughput is the engine's measured accumulation rate (the aggregation step) on silicon. End-to-end system throughput additionally depends on the data-ingest path; ATOMiK's order-independence means ingest needs no global ordering or locks, which is exactly what caps a conventional aggregator.
